questions.topic: Two accounts of the 1950s economic boom
questions.learningObjective: Evaluate the legacy of the boom

stimulus.body: Source note: It established mass consumption and welfare states that shaped later decades. This is the claim the evidence in the topic supports.

questions.stem: A note about two accounts of the 1950s economic boom says: "It established mass consumption and welfare states that shaped later decades" Against that evidence, what is the lasting legacy of the 1950s economic boom in Western Europe?

options.text: It established mass consumption and welfare states that shaped later decades.
It permanently ended all economic inequality.
options.misconception: mistakes It permanently ended all economic inequality for It established mass consumption and welfare states that shaped….

options.text: It caused immediate deindustrialization.
options.misconception: confuses It caused immediate deindustrialization with the supported claim It established mass consumption and welfare states that shaped….

options.text: It dissolved all national borders.
options.misconception: reads the evidence as It dissolved all national borders instead of It established mass consumption and welfare states that shaped….

questions.explanation: The boom's legacy includes mass consumption and welfare states; ended inequality, immediate deindustrialization, or dissolved borders are inaccurate.
